title: Account Balance
text: Queries the balance of an M-Pesa paybill or till account. Results are delivered asynchronously via callback.

title: Age on Network
text: Retrieves the registration date and duration a customer has been on the Safaricom network.

title: B2B Express
text: B2B Express (Lipa na M-Pesa B2B / USSD push) lets a partner trigger a USSD prompt on a customer's phone to authorize a B2B payment, resolving the

title: B2B (Business to Business)
text: Moves funds between two business accounts using the Buy Goods or Pay Bill command. Both operations share the same endpoint but differ by CommandID.

title: B2C Account Top-Up
text: Tops up a business M-Pesa account from another business account. Uses the same endpoint as B2B but with a dedicated CommandID.

title: B2C (Business to Customer)
text: Disburses funds from a business account to a customer's M-Pesa wallet (e.g. salary payments, business payments, promotions).

title: Bill Manager
text: Create, send, reconcile, and cancel invoices via the M-Pesa Bill Manager API.

title: Business Buy Goods
text: Sends a payment from a business account to a buy goods (till) merchant. This is a convenience wrapper around the B2B endpoint with CommandID set to BusinessBuyGoods.

title: Business Pay Bill
text: Sends a payment from a business account to a paybill merchant. This is a convenience wrapper around the B2B endpoint with CommandID set to BusinessPayBill.

title: Business to Pochi La M-Pesa (B2Pochi)
text: Sends a payment from a business account to a Pochi La M-Pesa wallet (personal mini-wallet for receiving business payments).

title: C2B (Customer to Business)
text: Registers confirmation/validation URLs for customer-initiated payments and simulates customer payments for testing.

title: Dynamic QR Code
text: Generates a dynamic QR code that customers can scan with the M-Pesa app to make a payment.

title: IMSI Lookup
text: Retrieves the IMSI (International Mobile Subscriber Identity) and related details for a given phone number.

title: IoT SIM Management
text: Manage IoT SIM cards via the Safaricom SIM Portal — list SIMs, query lifecycle, activate, rename, suspend, and send messages.

title: Lipa Na Bonga
text: Calculate Bonga Points redemption value and redeem points to pay for goods/services.

title: Mobile Center (Data Bundles)
text: Fetch, purchase, and check status of mobile data bundle offers via the Dynamic Offers API.

title: Mobile Number Validation (KYC)
text: Validates a mobile phone number against a government-issued ID to verify the subscriber's identity.

title: Mpesa Ratiba (Standing Orders)
text: Mpesa Ratiba lets a business create a standing order with Safaricom so that M-Pesa payments are made automatically on a recurring basis.

title: Pull Transactions
text: Register to receive transaction notifications and query historical pull transactions for a business shortcode.

title: Query Organization Info
text: Retrieves organization information (short code, name, charge profile) for a given M-Pesa identifier.

title: Reversal
text: Reverses a completed M-Pesa transaction. The reversal amount must not exceed the original transaction amount.

title: STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online)
text: Initiates a USSD prompt (STK push) on the customer's phone to authorize a payment.

title: STK Push Query
text: Queries the result of a previously initiated STK push request.

title: SIM Swap Date Query
text: Retrieves the last SIM swap date for a given customer phone number.

title: Tax Remittance
text: Remits tax payments to the Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) via M-Pesa. Uses a dedicated endpoint with CommandID set to PayTaxToKRA.

title: Transaction Status
text: Queries the status of a previously initiated M-Pesa transaction. You can look up by TransactionID or OriginalConversationID.

title: B2B Express Checkout Callback
text: When a B2B Express Checkout transaction completes, Safaricom POSTs a callback to the callbackUrl you provided in the request.

title: C2B Callback
text: When a customer pays via Pay Bill or Buy Goods, Safaricom sends two callbacks to the URLs you registered with c2b_register_url: 1. Validation — sent *before* the transaction completes; you can accept or reject it.

title: Result Callback (B2C / B2B / Reversal / Transaction Status / Account Balance / Ratiba / Tax Remittance)
text: Asynchronous API requests (B2C, B2B Buy Goods/Pay Bill, Reversal, Transaction Status, Account Balance, Ratiba, Tax Remittance) deliver their outcomes via a ResultURL callback. All use the same MpesaResult envelope.

title: STK Push Callback
text: When an STK Push completes (or fails), Safaricom POSTs a JSON payload to the CallBackURL you provided in the original request.

title: Error Handling
text: All SDKs share the same error hierarchy. Every error extends a base MpesaError that carries a human-readable message plus optional diagnostic fields.

title: Configuration
text: Every SDK is configured through an MpesaConfig-style object. The core options are shared across Python, TypeScript, and Go.

title: Installation
text: Each SDK is distributed on its ecosystem's package registry. All share the same API design and require the M-Pesa credentials from your Daraja developer
